s09_f00e: General, do not listen to Yuri's lies!
He is of no further concern to us.
We have more important business at hand.
President Dugan has appeared in San Antonio, Texas.
Perhaps he intends to withdraw to the Alamo.
Capture him again and bring him under our control.
s09_p01e: You can search every last inch, but you will never find me,
and you will never capture me.
And you call yourself a general?
We're laughing at you, you lousy Red Army fools!
